items.title: Cheval Collection launches Cheval South Bay in Dubai South
items.summary: A 193-unit mixed scheme: 98 serviced hotel apartments (studio to 3-bedroom) and 95 branded residences (1 to 3 bedrooms), scheduled to open in 2030. Prices are not yet disclosed; sales are expected to start next year.

items.title: DAMAC signs Dh3bn land deal for Al Zorah creek waterfront
items.summary: DAMAC signed a land agreement for a Dh3bn creek-side programme in Al Zorah. Phase 1 is two towers with 421 homes (studios to 3-bedroom apartments and loft residences), with launch expected in Q1 2027.

items.title: Bay Estate reportedly sold 350+ units in seven hours
items.summary: Reported sales of more than 350 villas, townhouses and land plots within seven hours of release, at starting prices of about AED 5.8 million. The figure is not yet confirmed by final transaction records.
